fragen.frage: What distinguishes an agent from a chatbot?
antworten: It carries out steps itself with tools
fragen.erklaerung: An agent acts: it runs commands, creates files and opens web pages.

fragen.frage: Where are your own files while the agent is working?
antworten: Separately on your computer – the agent can't get at them
fragen.erklaerung: The agent only works in the Agent PC. Your own computer and your files stay separate.
